scope: Read-only preflight of scratch V8 actual-owner entry controller and worksheet. No runtime, repo edits, diagnostic, owner or profile execution.
worksheet_binding: Controller SHA-256 and size 3717 bytes match worksheet. Owner probe output path conforms to its prefix requirement and initially absent.

finding.issue: Terminal receipt lost for malformed or partial owner report
finding.detail: After group timeout kill/reap and after snapshot, existing out is parsed with json.loads before the receipt is opened. Empty, truncated, invalid JSON or unreadable output throws and produces no terminal receipt; a hard timeout can interrupt writeFileSync.
finding.fix: Record raw output path, size and digest when present; catch decode/JSON/type errors and place descriptive failure in exclusive terminal receipt, preserving the original output. Avoid treating malformed/partial output as a successful owner result. Also capture snapshot/log errors as structured terminal status where possible, without hiding failure.

observations: Pinned node path, --prof explicit fresh /tmp logfile, output prefix, fresh exclusive receipt, 4096 heap, separate session, deadline=180s and killpg(SIGKILL)/communicate reap on timeout are explicit. Full qualification remains unprofiled 1800s and is not claimed.

Pre/post snapshots enumerate both roots tracked paths, reject symlinks/nonregular tracked files, hash size and bytes and capture both HEADs. Identical aggregate hashes/counts are supported by exact in-memory before/after equality. The tracked-only snapshot does not independently cover untracked or ignored owner inputs, TypeScript peer bytes, directory population, modes or Git repository internals; do not state all owner source or environment bytes are bound by this snapshot.

Snapshot before captures current HEAD but is not compared to a separately supplied expected post-worksheet-commit identity. Record immutable post-commit HEADs and V7 provenance externally, ensure the diagnostic source cut contains the passing source code plus approved worksheet/receipt additions, and prevent stale reused output.

Git snapshot function strips inherited GIT_* variables, but the owner child inherits GIT_* other than RC_ variables. Some actual owner Git calls inherit environment. For reproducible immutable source attribution, sanitize potentially redirecting Git environment in child as well or explicitly bind and verify clean environment.

No broad cleanup is performed; output/log are preserved. Group kill covers ordinary descendants in the same process group; a process that deliberately creates a separate session is not covered. On launcher interruption or unexpected communicate failure, lifecycle and receipt are not explicitly protected by a top-level finally; add cleanup/failure receipt if this controller must guarantee those cases.

V7 passed-fault counts are externally supplied and not independently checked here; prior V9 timeout or hypothetical hotspot is not proof of this diagnostic’s reached stack. No performance, full owner, product, release, C04 or G11 conclusion follows.
